title: Survival: death screen and grey overlay stay up after the round respawns you
body: Reported in play (CTF, Survival on, Nuubia): after dying you wait for the next round; when the round reset respawned the player, 'You were killed by Red Bot 5 [Grenade] / Waiting for next round...' and the desaturated overlay stayed on screen while playing. Cause: main._spawn_player (single player) ended the spectator cam but never called hud._hide_death(); the normal respawn only hid it by the countdown reaching 0, and Survival has no countdown (-1).
